title: Data Protection / Privacy Analyst
summary: A privacy analyst makes sure a company collects and uses personal data lawfully under India's DPDP Act 2023 and laws such as GDPR. They sit in a legal, risk or security team and work with product teams on consent, data flows and breaches.
dailyDuties: Apply the DPDP Act and GDPR to real processing activities
Run DPIAs (data protection impact assessments) and keep records of processing
Manage consent and map where personal data flows
Review processors and data processing agreements
Write privacy notices and internal policies
Assess personal data breaches and notify the Data Protection Board, CERT-In and users on time
Explain privacy duties to product and legal teams

skills.expectation: Apply India's DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR to real processing activities
Run DPIAs, keep records of processing and manage consent
Classify data and track where personal data flows
Review processors and data processing agreements
Write privacy notices and internal policies
Know ISO 27701 and how it extends ISO 27001
Run a personal data breach: assess harm and notify the Data Protection Board, CERT-In and users on time
Explain privacy duties to product and legal teams

certifications.why: Indian privacy certificate covering the DPDP Act
